notes.title: DomJudge version
notes.html:
Given again in the DomJudge Stacks and Queues set (14 Sep), with this input/output format:

Input: line 1 has the string num; line 2 has k.
Output: the smallest possible number as a string (no leading zeros; 0 if all digits are removed).

Input:
1432219
3
Output: 1219
Input:
10200
1
Output: 200
Input:
10
2
Output: 0

Constraints: 1 <= |num| <= 105, 0 <= k <= |num|.
